summary: A Stereolabs community forum thread in which user Jian reports that the ros2 rviz2 example (launched via zed_display_rviz2 display_zed2i.launch.py) fails on a Jetson AGX Orin Dev Kit with a ZED 2i camera, even though ROS2 and the ZED ROS2 wrapper installed successfully. The error is a failed load of the grid_map_rviz_plugin/GridMap display plugin plus an invalid frame ID 'map' warning. Myzhar suggests installing ros-humble-grid-map-rviz-plugin, then notes the plugin is not required and advises removing the Local Grid Map display; he also asks whether the zed_wrapper zed2i.launch.py command works. Jian finds that launching zed_wrapper first downloads and optimizes the model, after which rviz2 works, though Jian is on ROS2 Foxy and could not find a Foxy equivalent of the plugin.
one_line: Forum thread on fixing a failing rviz2 ZED 2i example on a Jetson AGX Orin, resolved by launching the zed_wrapper first.
key_facts: Jian was trying to follow the Stereolabs tutorial 'Getting Started with ROS 2 on Jetson AGX Orin' to configure ROS2 on a Jetson AGX Orin Dev Kit.
The rviz example was launched with the command: ros2 launch zed_display_rviz2 display_zed2i.launch.py.
The error log reported that the plugin for class 'grid_map_rviz_plugin/GridMap' failed to load.
The rviz2 log also showed the warning: Invalid frame ID "map" passed to canTransform argument target_frame - frame does not exist.
The ZED SDK version shown in the log was 4.0.3 - Build 72471_a14c21bc.
Myzhar suggested installing the package ros-humble-grid-map-rviz-plugin with sudo apt install.
Jian was using ROS2 Foxy, not Humble, and could not find a Foxy equivalent of the grid map plugin.
Myzhar stated that the grid map plugin is not required and that the Local Grid Map object can be removed from the rviz configuration to stop the warning.
Myzhar asked whether the command ros2 launch zed_wrapper zed2i.launch.py works correctly.
On June 6, 2023, Jian reported that ros2 launch zed_wrapper zed2i.launch.py worked, downloading and optimizing the model.
After the zed_wrapper launch succeeded, the rviz2 command started to work for Jian.
The Local Grid Map checkbox was unchecked in Jian's rviz setup.
The thread is in the Stereolabs Forums under the Software and ROS2 categories and is tagged ros, jetson and python.
